fields.name: INSTCODE
fields.title: Holding institution code
fields.description: Code of the institute where the accession is maintained. Use the WIEWS institute code (http://www.fao.org/wiews) if available.

fields.name: ACCENUMB
fields.title: Accession number
fields.description: This is the unique identifier for accessions within a genebank, and is assigned when a sample is entered into the genebank collection. Once assigned this number should never be reassigned to another accession in the collection.

fields.name: COLLNUMB
fields.title: Collector's accession number
fields.description: Original identifier assigned by the collector(s) of the sample, normally composed of the name or initials of the collector(s) followed by a number.

fields.name: COLLCODE
fields.title: Collecting institute code
fields.description: FAO WIEWS code of the institute that has collected the sample.

fields.name: COLLNAME
fields.title: Collecting institute name
fields.description: Name of the institute that collected the sample. This is only required if 'COLLCODE' is not available.

fields.name: COLLINSTADDRESS
fields.title: Collecting institute address
fields.description: Address of the institute that has collected the sample.

fields.name: ACCENAME
fields.title: Accession name
fields.description: Either a registered or other designation given to the accession. Multiple names are separated by a semicolon without space.

fields.name: GENUS
fields.title: Genus
fields.description: Genus name for taxon. Initial uppercase letter required.

fields.name: SPECIES
fields.title: Species
fields.description: Specific epithet portion of the scientific name in lowercase letters. Only the following abbreviation is allowed: 'sp.'

fields.name: SPAUTHOR
fields.title: Species authority
fields.description: Provide the authority for the species name.

fields.name: SUBTAXA
fields.title: Subtaxon
fields.description: Subtaxon can be used to store any additional taxonomic identifier. The following abbreviations are allowed: 'subsp.' (for subspecies); 'convar.' (for convariety); 'var.' (for variety); 'f.' (for form); 'Group' (for cultivar group).

fields.name: SUBTAUTHOR
fields.title: Subtaxon authority
fields.description: Provide the subtaxon authority at the most detailed taxonomic level.

fields.name: CROPNAME
fields.title: Common crop name
fields.description: Common name of the crop. Example: malting barley, lambs lettuce.

fields.name: ACCENAME
fields.title: Accession name
fields.description: Either a registered or other designation given to the accession.

fields.name: ACQDATE
fields.title: Acquisition date
fields.description: Date on which the accession entered the collection (YYYYMMDD or YYYY-MM-DD or partial: YYYY-MM or YYYY).

fields.name: ORIGCTY
fields.title: Country of origin
fields.description: 3-letter ISO 3166 country code of the country in which the sample was originally collected.

fields.name: COLLSITE
fields.title: Location of collecting site
fields.description: Name of the site where the sample was collected. Farm, village, etc. as appropriate.

fields.name: DECLATITUDE
fields.title: Latitude of collecting site (decimal)
fields.description: Latitude expressed in decimal degrees. Positive values are North of the Equator; negative values are South of the Equator. Example: +24.9; -25.0.

fields.name: LATITUDE
fields.title: Latitude of collecting site (DMS)
fields.description: Latitude expressed in DMS format: DDMMSS + compass direction (N or S), e.g. 0104500N.

fields.name: DECLONGITUDE
fields.title: Longitude of collecting site (decimal)
fields.description: Longitude expressed in decimal degrees. Positive values are East of the Greenwich Meridian; negative values are West of the Greenwich Meridian. Example: +15.87; -15.87.

fields.name: LONGITUDE
fields.title: Longitude of collecting site (DMS)
fields.description: Longitude expressed in DMS format: DDDMMSS + compass direction (E or W), e.g. 0174530W.

fields.name: COORDUNCERT
fields.title: Coordinate uncertainty
fields.description: Uncertainty associated with the coordinates in meters. Leave the value empty if the uncertainty is unknown.

fields.name: GEOREFMETH
fields.title: Geo-referencing method
fields.description: The geo-referencing method used (GPS, estimation from map, estimation calculated from village, etc.)

fields.name: ELEVATION
fields.title: Elevation of collecting site
fields.description: Elevation of collecting site expressed in meters above sea level. Negative values are allowed.

fields.name: COLLDATE
fields.title: Collecting date of sample
fields.description: Collecting date of the sample (YYYYMMDD or YYYY-MM-DD or partial: YYYY-MM or YYYY).

fields.name: BREDCODE
fields.title: Breeder's institute code
fields.description: FAO WIEWS code of the institute that has bred the material.

fields.name: BREDNAME
fields.title: Breeder's institute name
fields.description: Name of the institute (or individual) that bred the material. Required if 'BREDCODE' is not available.

fields.name: SAMPSTAT
fields.title: Biological status of accession
fields.description: The coding scheme proposed can be used at 3 different levels of detail: either by using the general codes (in boldface) such as 100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600, 999; or by using the more specific codes.

fields.name: ANCEST
fields.title: Pedigree
fields.description: Brief explanation of the pedigree or other description of the parental information, by which the variety, line, mutant, etc. was obtained.

fields.name: COLLSRC
fields.title: Collecting/acquisition source
fields.description: The coding scheme proposed can be used at 2 different levels of detail: either by using the general codes such as 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 99; or by using the more specific codes.

fields.name: DONORCODE
fields.title: Donor institute code
fields.description: FAO WIEWS code of the donor institute.

fields.name: DONORNAME
fields.title: Donor institute name
fields.description: Name of the donor institute.

fields.name: DONORNUMB
fields.title: Donor's accession number
fields.description: Identifier assigned to an accession by the donor.

fields.name: OTHERNUMB
fields.title: Other identification numbers
fields.description: Any other identification number(s) known to exist in other collections for this accession.

fields.name: DUPLSITE
fields.title: Location of safety duplicates
fields.description: FAO WIEWS code of the institute(s) where a safety duplicate of the accession is maintained.

fields.name: DUPLINSTNAME
fields.title: Name of institution with safety duplicate
fields.description: Name of the institute where a safety duplicate of the accession is maintained.

fields.name: STORAGE
fields.title: Type of germplasm storage
fields.description: If the accession is maintained under different types of storage, multiple choices are allowed (separated by a semicolon). MCPD v2 additions are marked with an asterisk (*).

fields.name: MLSSTAT
fields.title: MLS status of the accession
fields.description: The coded value referring to whether an accession is part of the Multilateral System (MLS) of the International Treaty on Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture (ITPGRFA).

fields.name: REMARKS
fields.title: Remarks
fields.description: The remarks field is used to add notes that are essential for understanding a record. Not used for additional information on a field.
